query_analysis.original_query: I need to develop a predictive model for eutectic salt formation in our deep eutectic solvent-based extraction process for rare earth elements. Can you help me characterize the thermodynamic boundaries?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a thermodynamic model to predict eutectic salt formation boundaries in a deep eutectic solvent system for rare earth element extraction

clarification_questions: What are the specific components of the deep eutectic solvent system?
What range of operating conditions (temperature, pressure) are you interested in?
Are there any known experimental data points for the system?
